calls.reason: LeCun's October 2019 tweet confirms Marcus criticized learning about quantities. It does not establish the broader list of criticisms Marcus attributes to his GPT-2 series.

The Fridman interview and DLD summary show overlapping concerns, but do not establish the full shared prescription. The AAAI tutorial shows others shared similar concerns; the claimed contrast remains unclear.

ACCORD documents reasoning failures, but ContPhy finds some physical reasoning successes and the Llama 2 study finds spatial and temporal representations. These mixed results do not settle what language training alone supplies.

The Nature paper reports AlphaGeometry solved 25 of 30 problems versus 10 for the prior best system. The NS-CL paper reports competitive results and better data efficiency, supporting achievements by other researchers too.
